description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewRepair' that extends SugarView, handling the display of the repair and rebuild functionality in SuiteCRM's administration module. It includes a method to trigger repair/clear operations and outputs a link back to the administration index.

classes.name: ViewRepair
classes.description: A class extending SugarView which handles displaying the repair and clear all modules functionality in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the SugarView's display method to perform a repair and clear all modules, then displays a return link.
